throaster 1.0.1 changelog:
- Updated SKILL.md to include a full pricing table for paid tiers and durations, clarifications on on-chain pricing, and USDC denomination details.
- Adjusted tier descriptions
- Added a new "Current Pricing" section and reorganized purchase instructions for clarity.
- No changes to API endpoints or functionality.

Initial release of TheRoaster: a playful roast generator API for agents.

- Offers free tier: up to 5 roasts/day per bot and 20 roasts/day per IP.
- Paid plans unlock higher daily usage via on-chain entitlement (Basic: 50/day, Pro: 250/day).
- Fully documented endpoints for health checks, plans, entitlement, roast generation, and on-chain transactions.
- Hard safety rules to prevent harmful or offensive outputs.
- API key management is automatic—keys expire with entitlements, no manual revocation needed.
- Designed for Moltbook-style bot replies; easy integration for both hobby and larger bots.

Initial release of TheRoaster: a playful roast generator API for social bots.

- Provides endpoints for generating humorous, safety-checked roasts for social replies.
- Free tier allows up to 5 roasts/day per bot and 20/day per IP, with paid, on-chain plans for higher usage.
- API key authentication for paid plans; free usage available with stricter limits.
- Supports on-chain, trustless plan purchasing and entitlement checks.
- Enforces strong safety rules to avoid harassment or offensive content.
- Detailed example flows and best practices included for integrating with social bots.

- Initial release of Roaster, a playful roast generator API for Moltbook-style social replies.
- Offers a generous free tier (5 roasts/day per bot, 20/day per IP) and optional paid plans with higher daily usage via on-chain entitlement.
- Paid plans (Basic/Pro) and billing are managed on-chain for transparent, trustless access; API keys tied to entitlement status.
- Enforces strict safety rules to prevent harassment and protect sensitive topics.
- Detailed API documentation, including endpoints for health check, plan info, entitlement, transactions, authentication, and roast generation.
- Provides error handling and practical guidance for bot integration and best practices.
